description: Totals from the Inaugural Donors Register, built from the Form 13 reports the 2025 presidential inaugural committee (Trump Vance Inaugural Committee, Inc., FEC C00894162) and the 2021 committee (PIC 2021, Inc., C00765040) filed with the FEC: each committee's cumulative printed totals, with donations accepted, refunded and net each labelled and kept apart, the filing ids and filing dates of the latest report and supplement and the coverage dates; organisations named against individual rows, individuals counted only; organisation money by reviewed type; the withheld categories as counts and amounts; the company families that gave in both 2021 and 2025, with their 2021 donations and share, never added across years; the LD-203 cross-check totals (registrants, items, exact, within $1 and differing counts, and each difference with both amounts and the line that neither record explains it), with the in-house registrants for whom no inaugural item was found given as totals only, never by name; the side-by-side coverage counts; and the register's headlines with their basis. Inaugural donations are not campaign contributions. Every answer carries the register's question note: the records describe donations reported to the FEC; they do not show what any donor received or intended, and they do not show cause and effect. Inaugural donations, contract obligations, connected-PAC contributions and lobbying reports are separate federal records, shown side by side and never added or put in sequence. Individual donors are counted, never named; withheld organisations (personal trusts, holding vehicles, businesses named for a person, names resting on initials) appear only as counts and amounts. Every answer quotes the FEC's restriction on the sale or use of individual contributor information (52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)).
name: inaugural_donors_summary
title: Get Inaugural Committee Donation Totals
